name: Twinleaf Area
description: The quiet southern start of Sinnoh around Twinleaf Town and Sandgem, spanning the early routes, Lake Verity, and Jubilife City.

name: Oreburgh Area
description: The rugged mining country east of Jubilife, home to Oreburgh City, its gate and mine, and the rocky cycling road.

name: Eterna Area
description: The flowery north around Floaroma Town and Eterna City, including the haunted Eterna Forest and the Old Chateau.

name: Hearthome Area
description: The central crossroads around Hearthome and Solaceon, dotted with the Lost Tower, the Solaceon Ruins, and the climb toward Mt. Coronet.

name: Pastoria Area
description: The marshy southeast around Pastoria City and the Great Marsh, ringed by seaside routes and the Valor Lakefront.

name: Celestic Area
description: The ancient heart of Sinnoh around Celestic Town and the towering Mt. Coronet that splits the region in two.

name: Canalave Area
description: The western harbour around Canalave City, the steel-laden Iron Island, and the open sea routes leading out to it.

name: Snowpoint Area
description: The frozen north around Snowpoint City, the snowbound routes, the Acuity Lakefront, and the icy Snowpoint Temple.

name: Sunyshore Area
description: The sun-baked east around Sunyshore City and the long road to the Pokémon League, climbing through Victory Road.
